universities.notes: No university-wide English test minimum published; interview language depends on the chosen programme.

english.detail: Tests from 2026-01-21: total 4 on the 1–6 scale; section minimums also apply.
Minimum 169; accepted Cambridge English exams include B2 First, C1 Advanced and C2 Proficiency.

tuition.detail: English-taught bachelor's fees range from €4,200 to €13,200 per year; no bachelor's tuition waivers for non-EU/EEA entrants.

universities.notes: The 2027-entry deadlines are not yet published; the listed date is for 2026 entry.
